environment_setting: Country B, City X, where a recent outbreak of a contagious disease has led to the implementation of serious disruption prevention orders requiring citizens to report their health status and movements within 3 days if requested.
norm_base: Citizens Failing to notify required information within 3 days when under serious disruption prevention order Breach of order penalties apply

legitimate.legitimate_action: Notify the required health and movement information within 3 days as per the disruption prevention order.
legitimate.benefits: Avoid penalties and comply with the law.
legitimate.costs: Loss of privacy and potential stigma if information is shared publicly.

illegal.illegal_action: Fail to notify the required health and movement information within 3 days.
illegal.benefits: Maintain privacy and avoid potential stigma.

character_profile.name: Emily Carter
character_profile.goal: Ensure compliance with disruption prevention orders to protect public health.

legitimate.legitimate_action: Follow up with Alex to ensure he submits the required information within the deadline.
legitimate.benefits: Promotes public health and ensures compliance.
legitimate.costs: Time-consuming and may face resistance from Alex.

illegal.illegal_action: Ignore Alex's non-compliance and avoid follow-up.
illegal.benefits: Saves time and avoids potential conflict.
illegal.costs: Risk of penalties for negligence and potential public health consequences.

character_profile.name: Michael Brown
character_profile.goal: Avoid disruptions to his work and personal life.

legitimate.legitimate_action: Encourage Alex to comply with the disruption prevention order.
legitimate.benefits: Helps maintain public health and avoids potential penalties for Alex.
legitimate.costs: May strain their friendship or lead to conflict.

illegal.illegal_action: Advise Alex to ignore the disruption prevention order and not report the required information.
illegal.benefits: Maintains their friendship and avoids conflict.
illegal.costs: Potential penalties for Alex and public health risks.
